title: 去年估值1830亿：如今IPO要1.4万亿，Anthropic凭什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Anthropic is said to price its IPO at the high end of its range.
segments.zh: Anthropic据称将其IPO定价在区间高端。

segments.en: Joining me now at the desk is Bloomberg Tecos Ed Ludlow, who is with us in studio in person Ed.
segments.zh: 现在加入我的是彭博科技的Ed Ludlow，他亲自来到演播室。Ed。

segments.en: Welcome. Talk to us about this breaking news. Is this expected?
segments.zh: 欢迎。跟我们谈谈这条突发新闻。这是意料之中的吗？

segments.en: Yes, the range was $70 to $78, so sources are saying the guide right now with the book closing 4pm this afternoon, $78 kind of the floor,
segments.zh: 是的，区间是70到78美元，所以消息人士称目前指导价，簿记今天下午4点关闭，78美元算是下限，

segments.en: and it's $78 a share that gets you to that fully diluted valuation of $1.4 trillion.
segments.zh: 每股78美元就能达到完全稀释后1.4万亿美元的估值。

segments.en: So let's see where it goes. I mean, in the conversations I've had in the last 24 hours, whatever happens this week, the expectation is that that $1.4 trillion
segments.zh: 所以看看它会怎么走。我的意思是，在过去24小时的对话中，无论本周发生什么，预期是那1.4万亿

segments.en: number kind of goes in the rearview mirror and it goes up and up and up as you know, happens on IPO dates.
segments.zh: 这个数字会逐渐成为过去，然后你知道的，在IPO日会不断上升。

segments.en: 825 million shares that are being marketed, so the chronology is the book closes Tuesday 4pm, final pricing Wednesday,
segments.zh: 8.25亿股正在营销中，所以时间线是周二下午4点簿记关闭，周三最终定价，

segments.en: trade and listening Thursday, all being well and equal.
segments.zh: 周四交易和聆听，一切顺利的话。
